title: SYZYGY ORBIT SNAP
models: procedural Web Audio for music/SFX (no Atlas)
own_art_list: All music and SFX: procedural Web Audio synthesizer in audio.js (no sample packs)
No external texture atlases; materials via surfaces.js / MeshStandardMaterial
what_i_found: SYZYGY turns a sun→object→craft alignment into a one-thumb arcade timing read: you do not steer or shoot—you feel the syzygy arrive, then SNAP at the right instant. The auto-orbit makes each approach legible while the portal micro-bonus and brief LOCK freeze add texture without changing the core rhythm. It feels like catching a celestial beat, not driving a racer or aiming a shooter.
